operations.title: Object creation, rename and immutable GUID/SID

scenarios.positive: Create and rename retain identity and valid naming context
scenarios.negative: Reject DN collisions, malformed SID and unauthorized object writes

exchanges.exchange: LDAP AddRequest for users, computers and groups
exchanges.expected_success: Create the authorized child with a server-assigned GUID and SID where applicable.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Return entryAlreadyExists for a DN collision and deny missing create rights; create no duplicate.
exchanges.required_evidence: LDAP result and before/after DN, GUID and SID inventory.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP ModifyRequest for attributes and group links
exchanges.expected_success: Commit the permitted change list atomically.
exchanges.expected_refusal: An invalid or denied change leaves the whole list unapplied.
exchanges.required_evidence: Result, redacted change types and before/after attributes and links.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP ModifyDNRequest within one domain, including newSuperior
exchanges.expected_success: Move or rename an authorized object with its GUID and SID intact.
exchanges.expected_refusal: A collision or missing move rights leaves the original object.
exchanges.required_evidence: Old and new DN, GUID, SID and result.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP DeleteRequest and Tree Delete control 1.2.840.113556.1.4.805
exchanges.expected_success: Delete an authorized leaf or selected authorized subtree.
exchanges.expected_refusal: An ordinary delete of a nonleaf returns notAllowedOnNonLeaf. Record any partial tree-delete progress.
exchanges.required_evidence: Result and per-entry deletion state.

operations.title: Schema, ACL inheritance and nested groups

scenarios.positive: Apply schema constraints, inherited rights and bounded nested membership
scenarios.negative: Hidden values act absent in results/filters; reject invalid classes and delegation; cyclic membership terminates without privilege amplification and resource exhaustion fails explicitly

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Add or Modify with schema and attribute constraints
exchanges.expected_success: Accept a valid authorized object or schema-scoped update.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Reject missing required attributes, invalid class, invalid syntax or malformed SID.
exchanges.required_evidence: Schema edition, result and before/after attributes.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Search and Modify with SD Flags control 1.2.840.113556.1.4.801
exchanges.expected_success: Return permitted descriptor fields and apply authorized ACL changes with observable inheritance.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Withhold protected fields and deny unauthorized writes without granting effective rights.
exchanges.required_evidence: SD mask, sanitized ACEs and effective rights before and after.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Search with Transitive Eval matching rule 1.2.840.113556.1.4.1941
exchanges.expected_success: Observe authorized nested membership and exclude hidden values from results and filters.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Hidden values remain unobservable; cycles grant no extra access and an exceeded Babel budget fails explicitly.
exchanges.required_evidence: Paired principals, search/filter outcomes and bounded cyclic/over-budget fixtures.

scenarios.positive: Restore the same eligible identity under the declared recycle profile
scenarios.negative: Reject expired restore and privilege resurrection without authorization

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Search with Show Deleted 1.2.840.113556.1.4.417 or Show Recycled 1.2.840.113556.1.4.2064
exchanges.expected_success: Authorized views expose the eligible lifecycle stages under the declared Recycle Bin profile.
exchanges.expected_refusal: A normal or unauthorized search does not expose protected deleted objects.
exchanges.required_evidence: Results for both controls, lifecycle state and scoped access identities.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Modify with Show Deleted, removal of isDeleted and replacement of distinguishedName
exchanges.expected_success: Restore an eligible object with its stable identity at a permitted DN.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Refuse expired, recycled, colliding or unauthorized restore without reviving privileges.
exchanges.required_evidence: GUID/SID, lifecycle state, target DN, result and effective access.

operations.title: Domain join, online login and reconnect

scenarios.positive: Join licensed Windows client and obtain real online domain authentication
scenarios.negative: Deny wrong credentials, revoked machine and broken secure channel

exchanges.exchange: LDAP computer Add or SAMR SamrCreateUser2InDomain (opnum 50)
exchanges.expected_success: Provision a computer account with intended trust role and scoped rights.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Reject a conflicting account or unauthorized takeover.
exchanges.required_evidence: Actual provisioning path, account ACL, directory identity and result.

exchanges.exchange: Netlogon NetrServerReqChallenge (4) and NetrServerAuthenticate3 (26)
exchanges.expected_success: Establish the protected channel for the enrolled machine.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Refuse wrong or revoked machine credentials and inadequate protection.
exchanges.required_evidence: RPC result, effective protection flags and successful post-join verification.

exchanges.exchange: Kerberos AS/TGS/AP or protected Netlogon SamLogonEx (39) when selected
exchanges.expected_success: A licensed Windows client proves online sign-in using the observed mechanism.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Wrong, expired per policy or revoked credentials yield no online session.
exchanges.required_evidence: Actual sign-in, correlated DC result, selected mechanism and cache classification.

exchanges.exchange: Windows fresh computer-account creation versus delegated reuse of an existing account, followed by protected channel establishment
exchanges.expected_success: A licensed build creates a new account or reuses the intended pre-staged account with the required rights, then establishes a protected machine channel and completes online logon.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Denied account creation or reuse leaves no usable machine channel or unintended account mutation.
exchanges.required_evidence: Fresh and pre-staged join pairs with effective reuse policy, account before/after identity, chosen interface, channel result and online logon.
exchanges.blocker: On each declared Windows edition/build observe the actual join route and current account-reuse policy, then compare Babel's directory, machine channel and online logon.

scenarios.positive: Rotate machine credentials and authenticate after restart
scenarios.negative: Reject replay and unauthorized account takeover; retain declared recovery behavior

exchanges.exchange: Netlogon NetrServerPasswordSet2 (opnum 30)
exchanges.expected_success: Rotate on the valid machine channel and authenticate after restart.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Invalid authenticator or unauthorized machine leaves credential state intact.
exchanges.required_evidence: Redacted status, authenticated scope, generation marker and restart probe.

exchanges.exchange: Re-establish channel after reply loss during machine password rotation
exchanges.expected_success: Reconcile only a permitted credential generation under the declared recovery policy.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Replay or out-of-policy old credentials gain no session.
exchanges.required_evidence: Before/after-commit interruption, account state and online result.

scenarios.positive: Exercise cached login then revalidate online after reconnect
scenarios.negative: Report offline login separately from online success and reject disallowed cached access

exchanges.exchange: Windows local cached interactive logon while isolated from all DCs
exchanges.expected_success: A previously enrolled user signs in offline only if local policy permits it.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Missing or disallowed cache prevents sign-in; offline success never counts as online.
exchanges.required_evidence: Policy and sign-in events, DC isolation and absence of server authentication.

exchanges.exchange: Fresh Kerberos AS or protected Netlogon authentication after reconnect
exchanges.expected_success: A valid identity obtains separately observed online authentication.
exchanges.expected_refusal: A subsequently revoked account fails the online attempt even with an existing cached desktop session.
exchanges.required_evidence: Offline/online classification, correlated times and DC state.

operations.title: Password change/reset, expiry and fine-grained policy

scenarios.positive: Authorized change/reset enforces effective policy and redacts credentials
scenarios.negative: Deny old-password mismatch, weak password and unauthorized helpdesk reset

exchanges.exchange: SamrUnicodeChangePasswordUser2 (opnum 55) for self-service change
exchanges.expected_success: Holder of old password changes it under effective policy and proves the new state.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Wrong old password or policy failure leaves the prior state.
exchanges.required_evidence: Redacted NTSTATUS and old/new login probes without passwords.

exchanges.exchange: SamrSetInformationUser2 (opnum 58) with permitted password information class
exchanges.expected_success: Delegated reset changes only the scoped account.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Out-of-scope helpdesk reset fails without changing the credential.
exchanges.required_evidence: Selected information class, granted scope, status, audit and post-reset probe.

exchanges.exchange: Protected LDAP Modify of unicodePwd with change or reset semantics
exchanges.expected_success: Change or reset succeeds under its distinct rights and protection requirements.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Weak password, inadequate protection or missing rights do not change credentials.
exchanges.required_evidence: Transport, redacted change shape, LDAP result and login probe.

exchanges.exchange: Kerberos change/set-password request and reply on port 464
exchanges.expected_success: An authorized change or reset returns application success.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Wrong old credentials or policy/rights failure leaves state unchanged.
exchanges.required_evidence: Actual client route, redacted application code and post-attempt login.

scenarios.positive: Enforce declared thresholds, unlock and disabled-account behavior
scenarios.negative: Resist enumeration and reject authentication after effective local revocation

exchanges.exchange: Observe account lockout during controlled AS/authentication attempts and SAMR policy checks
exchanges.expected_success: Apply the effective threshold and permit an eligible identity after authorized unlock.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Locked or disabled account fails online; outward behavior limits enumeration.
exchanges.required_evidence: Ordered attempts, effective policy, counters, redacted outcomes and unlock audit.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Modify to clear lockoutTime under delegated rights
exchanges.expected_success: Clear the authorized lockout while leaving the disabled flag intact.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unauthorized unlock leaves state and online refusal unchanged.
exchanges.required_evidence: Before/after attributes, result and online check.

scenarios.positive: Obtain AES tickets and use them at a separately authenticated service
scenarios.negative: Reject replay, expiry, clock skew and disallowed encryption downgrade

exchanges.exchange: KRB_AS_REQ / KRB_AS_REP for AES TGT and preauthentication
exchanges.expected_success: A valid client obtains a TGT with a permitted AES enctype.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Invalid preauthentication, disabled account or no common approved enctype yields an applicable KRB_ERROR and no usable TGT.
exchanges.required_evidence: AS status/enctype and policy decision; distinguish initial preauthentication challenge from final refusal.

exchanges.exchange: KRB_TGS_REQ / KRB_TGS_REP for a selected service principal
exchanges.expected_success: A valid TGT obtains a service ticket bounded to the selected SPN.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Expired or invalid authorization or unknown SPN yields no usable ticket.
exchanges.required_evidence: TGS status, enctype and masked principal/realm/SPN.

exchanges.exchange: KRB_AP_REQ and mutual KRB_AP_REP at a separate service
exchanges.expected_success: The service accepts its own ticket and provides proof when mutual authentication is requested.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Wrong audience, expiry, replayed authenticator or unacceptable skew yields no authenticated session.
exchanges.required_evidence: Client/service results, replay/skew timing and exact protocol or application refusal.

exchanges.exchange: Isolated DNS and time sources before Kerberos login
exchanges.expected_success: Observe successful online tickets and AP exchange with time within policy.
exchanges.expected_refusal: With isolated clock skew above policy, the request fails and no service session is established.
exchanges.required_evidence: Record both clocks, skew, authenticating protocol result and recovery after synchronization.

scenarios.positive: Validate PAC and permitted service delegation against the reference
scenarios.negative: Reject forged PAC, unintended audience and unapproved delegation targets

exchanges.exchange: Ticket AuthorizationData with PAC and context-appropriate signatures
exchanges.expected_success: Verify applicable signatures and derive the expected user/group authority.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Reject tampered PAC or wrong signing context; grant no PAC-derived authority.
exchanges.required_evidence: Redacted ticket context, verification by signature role and effective rights.

exchanges.exchange: S4U2self TGS extension with PA-S4U-X509-USER or PA-FOR-USER as selected
exchanges.expected_success: Permitted service obtains a ticket to itself for the expected represented user.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Invalid or disallowed request fails; a fallback ticket naming the service as client is insufficient.
exchanges.required_evidence: Service, represented user, target and KDC result as redacted metadata.

exchanges.exchange: S4U2proxy TGS extension with permitted evidence ticket and delegation policy
exchanges.expected_success: Permitted delegator receives a ticket to the intended target for the user.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Ineligible evidence or target yields no usable delegated ticket.
exchanges.required_evidence: Scoped policy, KDC decision and destination service result.

scenarios.positive: Compare base-scope anonymous discovery and supported bounded filter truth
scenarios.negative: Reject malformed BER, unsupported scope and over-budget nesting without leaking data

exchanges.exchange: LDAPv3 anonymous Bind followed by Unbind
exchanges.expected_success: Anonymous bind permits declared public discovery and Unbind terminates without a response PDU.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Invalid version or disallowed credential path yields no authenticated access.
exchanges.required_evidence: Sanitized bind/unbind and connection lifecycle with scope verification.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Search on empty base DN with baseObject scope and selected RootDSE attributes
exchanges.expected_success: Return declared discovery data and SearchResultDone; false filter yields no entries.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unsupported scope or filter receives declared refusal without wider directory data.
exchanges.required_evidence: Scope, attributes, filter and terminal code; distinguish Babel smoke from Windows comparison.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP BER message framing and Notice of Disconnection where applicable
exchanges.expected_success: Valid bounded messages complete and unrelated sessions remain available.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Undecodable input closes under the framing rules. Record a notice or protocolError if available.
exchanges.required_evidence: Bounded parser diagnostics, disconnect outcome and next clean session.

operations.title: LDAPS, controls, paging, referrals and ACL filtering

scenarios.positive: Read authorized objects with declared controls and stable page behavior
scenarios.negative: Deny unsigned insecure credential paths and unauthorized attributes or controls

exchanges.exchange: LDAP StartTLS 1.3.6.1.4.1.1466.20037, LDAPS and SASL GSSAPI/GSS-SPNEGO Bind
exchanges.expected_success: Authorize a bind in the approved TLS or SASL context.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unsigned or unprotected credential path or failed TLS/channel-binding policy grants no session or cleartext fallback.
exchanges.required_evidence: Transport, certificate/binding decision, SASL security and LDAP result.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Search and Compare with authorized referrals
exchanges.expected_success: Return authorized projections, the applicable compare result or a declared eligible referral.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Do not disclose hidden values or forward credentials to an untrusted referral.
exchanges.required_evidence: Result entries, LDAP code, referral and actual client handling.

exchanges.exchange: Simple Paged Results control 1.2.840.113556.1.4.319 with continuation and abandonment
exchanges.expected_success: Return complete pages over fixed data with opaque continuation and empty final cookie.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Invalid, expired or wrong-scope cookies do not expose a different result set.
exchanges.required_evidence: Counts and authorized IDs by page, cookie presence and terminal code.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP control criticality and unsupported OID handling
exchanges.expected_success: Apply a supported control and use the ignore rule for unknown noncritical controls.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unknown critical control returns unavailableCriticalExtension and suppresses the operation.
exchanges.required_evidence: Advertised set, requested OID/criticality, result and absence of side effects.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Search DirSync request and returned continuation cookie
exchanges.expected_success: An authorized search of the NC root returns eligible changed objects and a cookie for continuation.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Reject an unsupported scope or unauthorized change enumeration without returning protected attributes.
exchanges.required_evidence: NC base, control flags, initial and resumed cookies represented without bytes, effective permissions and result, correlated with fixture mutations.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Search single-attribute server-side sort with optional Virtual List View window
exchanges.expected_success: A supported sort returns ordered results and a supported VLV request returns the declared window around the selected target.
exchanges.expected_refusal: An invalid sort or VLV request cannot report a valid sorted window. Apply control criticality on unsupported requests.
exchanges.required_evidence: Requested sort key, window and criticality, compared result codes and control responses, and entry order on the same synthetic dataset.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP Search attribute description range option for a multivalued attribute
exchanges.expected_success: Sequential ranges on an unchanged attribute and connection return the requested slices and terminal range marker.
exchanges.expected_refusal: A range request preserves attribute access checks. An absent result cannot be counted as a completed authorized read.
exchanges.required_evidence: Requested and returned range descriptions with terminal marker, number of values, connection identity and an unauthorized-read comparison.

exchanges.exchange: RSAT combinations and criticality for paging, DirSync, sort/VLV and ranged attributes
exchanges.expected_success: Publish a combination after its semantics and authorization are qualified.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unknown critical controls fail and unqualified controls remain outside support.
exchanges.required_evidence: Exact tool/build traces, continuation and refusal behavior.
exchanges.blocker: Individually defined controls and attribute options have mappings. The exact option combinations, flags and criticality selected by each installed RSAT build need an observed read and denial.

operations.title: Global catalog and partial attribute sets

scenarios.positive: Return authorized cross-domain partial attributes with declared freshness
scenarios.negative: Reject out-of-scope secrets and unsupported GC semantics explicitly

exchanges.exchange: GC LDAP/LDAPS, isGlobalCatalogReady and search of partial replica naming contexts
exchanges.expected_success: Ready catalog returns authorized partial attributes across qualified domains.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Do not return out-of-scope secrets or advertise unavailable catalog readiness.
exchanges.required_evidence: Two-domain full/partial comparisons, freshness/readiness and result.

operations.title: DNS SRV, sites/subnets and DC locator

scenarios.positive: Locate an eligible DC and fail over after DNS/DC loss
scenarios.negative: Exclude stale records and disallowed site placement; bound locator timeout

exchanges.exchange: DNS QUERY for site/domain SRV and target host records
exchanges.expected_success: Locate an eligible service with matching site and priority/weight selection.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Separate NXDOMAIN from empty answer; stale or unreachable records do not qualify as live DCs.
exchanges.required_evidence: Redacted queries/RRsets/TTLs, selected DC and bounded failover time.

exchanges.exchange: UDP LDAP Netlogon ping and DsrGetDcNameEx2 (34) where invoked
exchanges.expected_success: Selected reachable responder satisfies domain, capability and site flags.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Wrong-domain or disallowed-site reply does not satisfy lookup; only declared fallback is allowed.
exchanges.required_evidence: Probe flags, resulting DC selection, actual reachability and timed loss.

exchanges.exchange: Legacy NetBIOS-based DC discovery and mailslot ping
exchanges.expected_success: If enabled and within a declared legacy profile, the client uses a valid reply to an in-scope mailslot ping.
exchanges.expected_refusal: When legacy discovery is disallowed, DNS loss grants no DC identity or network escape.
exchanges.required_evidence: Effective NetBIOS policy and client build, DNS loss and recovery, observed mailslot presence or absence and selected DC.

exchanges.exchange: Whether a declared build and policy need legacy discovery after DNS loss
exchanges.expected_success: Use the selected DNS path on the supported baseline.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unqualified legacy fallback earns no support and cannot route outside the isolated topology.
exchanges.required_evidence: Exact builds/settings and observed behavior under DNS loss.
exchanges.blocker: The wire route is mapped. Capture effective NetBIOS/locator policy and observed failover or bounded failure on the four pinned Windows profiles to decide whether any legacy route belongs in scope.

scenarios.positive: Authorize and persist signed machine-owned record updates
scenarios.negative: Reject unsigned updates, replay and writes to another machine record

exchanges.exchange: TKEY exchanges for GSS-TSIG context establishment
exchanges.expected_success: Establish a context for the permitted machine and DNS service.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Invalid GSS authentication yields no update context.
exchanges.required_evidence: Redacted TKEY/GSS state, scoped identities and return status.

exchanges.exchange: DNS UPDATE with prerequisites, update sections and GSS-TSIG signature
exchanges.expected_success: Commit only the authorized RRset change for a valid signed update.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Reject unsigned, invalid, unauthorized or stale updates and failed prerequisites without RRset mutation.
exchanges.required_evidence: RCODE and TSIG outcome, before/after RRsets and duplicate/retry observation.

exchanges.exchange: DNS management RPC R_DnssrvUpdateRecord (4), UpdateRecord2 (9) and UpdateRecord3 (10)
exchanges.expected_success: An authorized management call returns success and applies the requested addition/deletion in the selected zone or supported scope.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unauthorized or unsupported management requests return an error with no record mutation.
exchanges.required_evidence: Tool/build, management opnum and effective rights, requested zone/scope, returned status and record before/after. Keep signed DNS UPDATE evidence separate.

exchanges.exchange: Selection of the supported DNS administration tool, RPC versions and zone scopes
exchanges.expected_success: Evaluate the selected administrative method independently of wire UPDATE.
exchanges.expected_refusal: No administrative method bypasses record ACLs or qualifies DNS UPDATE.
exchanges.required_evidence: Exact DNS management client, RPC authorization and outcomes.
exchanges.blocker: The publisher defines opnums 4, 9 and 10. Decide which management journeys Babel supports and capture the actual route and access refusal on the approved tools. Signed machine updates use the separate DNS UPDATE rows.

operations.title: GPO creation, linking, resultant policy and revert

scenarios.positive: Real Windows client applies linked policy with expected resultant settings
scenarios.negative: Deny unauthorized links/edits and reject stale or incomplete policy publication

exchanges.exchange: LDAP GPO/SOM search and SMB read of the paired file version
exchanges.expected_success: Windows evaluates eligible links and consumes coherent directory/file versions.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Incomplete publication never counts as a newly applied policy; record prior cached policy separately.
exchanges.required_evidence: Selected links, GPC/GPT versions, client resultant policy and incomplete-publication observation.

exchanges.exchange: LDAP GPO-link update and directory/SYSVOL versioned publishing
exchanges.expected_success: A delegated editor updates the intended link and publishes a coherent version.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unauthorized change fails, and partial publication remains visible as incomplete.
exchanges.required_evidence: LDAP/SMB results, before/after link and version state, actual client application.

exchanges.exchange: Select extension-specific GPO lists by user/computer CSE GUID and invoke applicable extensions
exchanges.expected_success: The client sees the applicable extension GUID for the correct policy mode and applies the relevant GPOs. Registry policy runs first.
exchanges.expected_refusal: A missing extension is excluded and a failed extension never counts as successful application for that extension.
exchanges.required_evidence: Policy mode and extension GUID, extension result, unaffected extension outcomes and real Windows resultant settings.

exchanges.exchange: Per-client Group Policy extension set for scripts and security policy
exchanges.expected_success: Apply each selected extension on exact Windows clients with resultant settings.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unqualified extensions and stale policy do not earn application evidence.
exchanges.required_evidence: Extension/version and client-side settings and events.
exchanges.blocker: Core extension selection/invocation is pinned. Select the actual scripts/security extension versions and file formats, then compare their outputs and failure behaviors on licensed clients.

operations.title: SYSVOL ACLs, scripts and content/version consistency

scenarios.positive: Read permitted signed/sealed policy content and reconcile interrupted publication
scenarios.negative: Deny unauthorized script writes and never advertise complete policy after partial publication

exchanges.exchange: SMB2 NEGOTIATE, SESSION_SETUP and TREE_CONNECT to SYSVOL/NETLOGON
exchanges.expected_success: Authenticate to the intended share with declared dialect and signing/sealing.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Invalid signature, inadequate protection or missing share rights yields no file access.
exchanges.required_evidence: Negotiated protection, SMB status, share and ACL.

exchanges.exchange: SMB2 CREATE, READ, WRITE and CLOSE for policy content
exchanges.expected_success: Authorized reads see expected files and an approved writer publishes a coherent version.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unauthorized writes fail, and interrupted publication cannot advance the complete version.
exchanges.required_evidence: SMB status, file/version hashes, before/after interruption evidence.

exchanges.exchange: Windows DFSR peer connection, session, version vector and record requests
exchanges.expected_success: A qualified Windows reference replication pair exchanges versions and records on an authorized session.
exchanges.expected_refusal: A refused or incomplete peer session may not make partial SYSVOL content appear converged.
exchanges.required_evidence: Reference DC builds, authorized peer/session outcomes, interrupted transfer and both peers' redacted file-version inventory.

exchanges.exchange: First-production Babel SYSVOL replication mechanism and Windows DFSR interoperability scope
exchanges.expected_success: Selected replication mechanism converges coherent policy files across DCs.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Deny unauthorized peers; incomplete file sets never count as converged.
exchanges.required_evidence: Two-site file convergence, peer authorization and interrupted propagation.
exchanges.blocker: The reference wire exchange is identifiable and FRS fallback is out of the declared 2016 profile. The Babel replication mechanism and any Windows coexistence commitment need a scope decision and multi-DC convergence/fault evidence.

scenarios.positive: Rejoin partitioned DCs and converge declared object/link outcomes
scenarios.negative: Reject unauthenticated replication, stale epochs and rollback cursor advancement

exchanges.exchange: IDL_DRSBind (0) and IDL_DRSUnbind (1) with supported extensions
exchanges.expected_success: An authorized protected peer negotiates a supported context and releases it.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unauthorized or insufficiently protected peer receives no context/data.
exchanges.required_evidence: Peer role, RPC protection, negotiated extensions and context lifetime.

exchanges.exchange: IDL_DRSGetNCChanges (3) with NC, cursors, linked values and continuation
exchanges.expected_success: Apply authorized changes, deduplicate retries and atomically commit progress with state.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Invalid cursor, stale epoch or unapproved peer does not advance progress.
exchanges.required_evidence: Partition/rejoin, redacted epochs/USNs, and transaction and object/link observations.

exchanges.exchange: IDL_DRSUpdateRefs (4), IDL_DRSReplicaSync (2) and IDL_DRSGetReplInfo (19)
exchanges.expected_success: Permit scoped topology/sync and report actual replica state.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unauthorized NC changes fail; queued sync is not successful convergence.
exchanges.required_evidence: Neighbors, requested NC, RPC result and follow-up cursors/metadata.

operations.title: Tombstones, lingering objects and restored DCs

scenarios.positive: Restore coherent state with a new qualified invocation epoch
scenarios.negative: Quarantine stale snapshots and prevent deleted objects from silently resurrecting

exchanges.exchange: GetNCChanges replication of retained deletions and link updates
exchanges.expected_success: Deletion and link lifecycle converge under the declared retention interval.
exchanges.expected_refusal: An obsolete replica cannot silently resurrect a deleted identity.
exchanges.required_evidence: Two-sided object/link states, lifetime settings, cursors and isolated rejoin.

exchanges.exchange: Offline restore and newly qualified invocation epoch before allowing replication
exchanges.expected_success: Reconcile a valid backup and resume under a coherent new epoch.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Quarantine reused epochs, rollback or incompatible snapshots without advancing peers.
exchanges.required_evidence: Backup ancestry, old/new invocation IDs and post-restore replication checks.

scenarios.positive: Complete required membership calls over authenticated protected channels
scenarios.negative: Reject downgrade, replay, wrong machine identity and unsupported opnums safely

exchanges.exchange: Protected NetrLogonGetCapabilities (21) and NetrLogonGetDomainInfo (29)
exchanges.expected_success: Return approved domain and capability data to the authenticated channel.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Bad authenticator, wrong machine or weak protection yields no protected result.
exchanges.required_evidence: Interface UUID/version, opnum, selected flags and NTSTATUS.

exchanges.exchange: NetrLogonSamLogonEx (39) or NetrLogonSamLogonWithFlags (45)
exchanges.expected_success: Return scoped validation data using a declared information level and protected channel.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Wrong identity, replay or unsupported information level grants no logon.
exchanges.required_evidence: Selected call/level, RPC protection and sanitized validation outcome.

exchanges.exchange: MS-NRPC wire interface v1.0 UUID 12345678-1234-ABCD-EF00-01234567CFFB, including legacy Authenticate (5), Authenticate2 (15), and Authenticate3 (26)
exchanges.expected_success: An in-profile call over the selected transport establishes a machine channel with the declared protection.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unexpected opnums and insufficient protection fail without creating or downgrading a channel.
exchanges.required_evidence: Interface version, selected transport and authentication level, declared and observed opnum and exact RPC/status result.

exchanges.exchange: Legacy opnums, interface versions, authentication levels and exact RPC faults
exchanges.expected_success: Offer only declared calls and interface versions.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unknown opnum or unsupported authentication receives a bounded refusal or RPC fault.
exchanges.required_evidence: Pinned UUID/opnum/authentication and result/fault pairing.
exchanges.blocker: UUID, interface version and named authentication opnums are pinned. Observe the selected transport, protection, legacy method use and native fault behavior on each exact patched Windows profile.

scenarios.positive: Delegate bounded administrative operations using supported RSAT/RPC calls
scenarios.negative: Deny privilege escalation, anonymous enumeration and raw secret export

exchanges.exchange: LsarOpenPolicy2 (44), LsarQueryInformationPolicy2 (46) and LsarSetInformationPolicy2 (47)
exchanges.expected_success: A delegated caller performs its authorized policy operation with scoped rights.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Anonymous or underprivileged requests fail without exporting secrets or altering policy.
exchanges.required_evidence: Requested and granted access, information class, protection, NTSTATUS and audit.

exchanges.exchange: SamrLookupNamesInDomain (17) under a scoped domain handle
exchanges.expected_success: Authorized lookup returns expected identity/RID mapping.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Deny unauthorized enumeration and return the appropriate unmapped-name result.
exchanges.required_evidence: Known, unknown and denied results with scope and returned count.

exchanges.exchange: RSAT route and complete LSA/SAMR/LDAP call and information-level selection
exchanges.expected_success: Each approved journey uses a mapped delegated path.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unknown routes stay unsupported and cannot grant authority.

exchanges.blocker: The named LSA policy and SAMR lookup methods are candidates. Observe actual call and information-level selection for each delegated console or PowerShell journey on an exact RSAT build, including any LDAP leg and the resulting denial.

operations.title: Forest/domain trust, selective authentication and SID filtering

scenarios.positive: Authenticate and authorize selected users across two disposable forests
scenarios.negative: Reject untrusted SID history, disallowed targets and removed trust credentials

exchanges.exchange: LsarCreateTrustedDomainEx2 (59) and LsarDeleteTrustedDomain (41)
exchanges.expected_success: Authorized tooling creates/removes the selected directional trust between isolated forests.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unauthorized changes fail; removed trust cannot supply new online authority.
exchanges.required_evidence: Directional TDO observations, audit and independent online checks without trust secrets.

exchanges.exchange: Cross-realm KRB_TGS referral and service authentication with SID filtering
exchanges.expected_success: Allowed origin obtains a service ticket and only approved SID-derived access.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Untrusted SID history, wrong direction or disallowed destination yields no protected access.
exchanges.required_evidence: Realm referral chain, filtered identity metadata and destination authorization results.

scenarios.positive: Move declared synthetic identities with stable mapping and documented cutover
scenarios.negative: Abort or roll back interrupted migration without duplicate SID/credential exposure

exchanges.exchange: LDAP cross-domain ModifyDN with target control and IDL_DRSInterDomainMove (10)
exchanges.expected_success: Authorized same-forest move preserves GUID with declared destination SID semantics.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Reject invalid target or unauthorized move without a duplicate live identity.
exchanges.required_evidence: Source/target DN, GUID/SID, transfer status and interrupted retry.

exchanges.exchange: IDL_DRSAddSidHistory (20) under explicitly qualified authority
exchanges.expected_success: Permitted migration maps the selected source and destination identities under SID-history policy.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Reject unauthorized additions and any raw credential export.
exchanges.required_evidence: Identity correspondence, audit and scoped access before/after.

exchanges.exchange: Cross-forest migration/coexistence tool and cutover path
exchanges.expected_success: Cut over the selected synthetic identity mapping with tested rollback.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Incomplete cutover leaves no duplicate live identity or exported credentials.
exchanges.required_evidence: Tool/build, actual calls, identity mapping and staged recovery.
exchanges.blocker: The same-forest domain move and inter-forest SID-history copy have distinct semantics. Choose the cross-forest tool, credential policy and cutover workflow, then exercise rollback and SID/credential handling on two qualified forests.

scenarios.positive: Advertise and enforce only the approved qualified functional profile
scenarios.negative: Reject unsupported level changes and interrupted irreversible transitions

exchanges.expected_refusal: Exclude unqualified capabilities and refuse incompatible transitions.

exchanges.expected_refusal: Refuse undeclared raise/downgrade without partial advertisement or update.

exchanges.exchange: Isolated forest/domain bootstrap and functional-profile verification
exchanges.expected_success: Create the selected 2016 domain/forest with distinct identities and the expected naming contexts.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Refuse unqualified levels, unsafe provisioning and partial initialization without exposing the service.
exchanges.required_evidence: Exact provisioning inputs, resulting NCs and identifiers, plus interrupted creation and cleanup artifacts.

scenarios.positive: Transfer roles and allocate non-overlapping RID ranges
scenarios.negative: Reject duplicate role authority and RID reuse after crash or restore

exchanges.expected_success: Transfer a scoped role and observe exactly one authoritative owner.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unauthorized or stale-owner request cannot create dual authority.
exchanges.required_evidence: Owner DN/epoch, RPC/LDAP outcomes and guarded writes at both peers.

exchanges.exchange: RID master and DRS FSMO RID allocation request
exchanges.expected_success: An eligible peer receives a non-overlapping RID allocation.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Reject stale authority and prevent RID range reuse after crash or restore.

scenarios.positive: Install, supervise, reboot, upgrade and remove the constrained native Linux service with declared ordering and persistent directory data preserved
scenarios.negative: Reject unsafe privileges, unsupported configuration, missing key providers and implicit directory-data deletion

operations.title: Linux SSSD/MIT Kerberos and macOS directory/Kerberos integration

scenarios.positive: Resolve identities/groups, enroll where supported, perform online login, password change and Kerberos service SSO on each exact Linux/macOS build
scenarios.negative: Reject revoked/expired identities and wrong realms; distinguish offline caches from online authentication and reject Windows-only policy claims

exchanges.exchange: Linux/macOS protected LDAP identity and group lookup when selected
exchanges.expected_success: Correct visible users/groups resolve through the declared OS integration.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Hidden values and disallowed lookups remain unavailable.
exchanges.required_evidence: Exact OS/package, lookup source, authorized/denied results and correlated wire evidence.

exchanges.exchange: Kerberos AS/AP and RFC 3244 password exchange where selected
exchanges.expected_success: Real OS proves online login, password change and scoped service SSO.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Rejected identity or wrong realm yields no online authentication; caches are separate.

scenarios.positive: Operate without a Samba daemon/database or Windows runtime on the Babel host
scenarios.negative: Reject unsupported platform/integration claims and direct management store access

exchanges.exchange: Native Linux process, package and dependency boundary
exchanges.expected_success: Serve from Babel without Windows or Samba daemon/database dependencies on the host.
exchanges.expected_refusal: An unsupported integration must not become a runtime dependency or support claim.

exchanges.exchange: Delegated management command crossing into the native service
exchanges.expected_success: The native service checks authorization and records the authenticated actor.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Direct store writes and unauthorized actions are blocked.

scenarios.positive: Restore target synthetic domain coherently within the measured RPO/RTO
scenarios.negative: Reject incompatible formats, missing keys and stale epoch reuse

exchanges.expected_success: Recover coherent state under a qualified new epoch and measure RPO/RTO.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Reject incompatible format, missing keys and stale epochs before opening service.
exchanges.required_evidence: Backup/source digests, recovery timeline and online verification.

exchanges.exchange: Operator upgrade, rotation, audit export and degraded health
exchanges.expected_success: Observe successful audited lifecycle operations and declared recovery.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Disk-full, audit loss or expired certificate exposes degraded/refusal status without false completion.

scenarios.positive: Complete supported administrator journeys with audit-correlated outcomes
scenarios.negative: Deny unauthorized API/UI actions, CSRF and misleading success on partial failure

exchanges.exchange: Authenticated web/API/CLI action through the authorized directory service
exchanges.expected_success: Complete a delegated accessible journey with auditable outcome.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Refuse unauthorized actions and CSRF and expose partial failures accurately.
exchanges.required_evidence: Accessibility results, API authorization tests, audit and durable state.

exchanges.exchange: Exact management routes, versioned request/result schema and commands
exchanges.expected_success: Expose only contract-versioned authorized routes after design and qualification.
exchanges.expected_refusal: Unknown or denied routes cannot mutate storage.
exchanges.required_evidence: Versioned API contract, identity, request/status, audit and UI correlation.
exchanges.blocker: Implement and publish the versioned CLI/API schema, authorization and audit boundaries, then run success, access denial and partial-failure journeys through the real Babel interface.

limitations: No Windows join/login/GPO evidence exists; every conformance scenario is unrun.
The native implementation is only a loopback read-only LDAP discovery lab.
No exact patched Windows/Linux image build is qualified.
RODC, AD CS, ADFS, Exchange schema, Entra synchronization, RADIUS and federation require separate compatibility decisions; this is not a claim of support.
No production support or multi-master compatibility is established by this inventory.

Non-Windows Linux and macOS identity/authentication are in the initial client profile. Native Windows GPO is not claimed on those systems; cross-platform policy/patch/remote/EDR agents have separate roadmap gates.

Mobile devices and network appliances are inventoried integration targets, not Windows domain-join/GPO clients; web federation, certificates and RADIUS require explicit later protocol/module qualification.
